title: Ergodic topology sampling toward the continuum with Stochastic Normalizing Flows
abstract: arXiv:2610.20747v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work we provide numerical evidence that topological freezing in $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ Yang-Mills theory can be mitigated with a flow-based approach, as tested at lattice spacings as fine as 0.03~fm. We do so by analyzing the scaling of the costs of a computational strategy based on the combination of open boundary conditions and Stochastic Normalizing Flows. We show that the integrated autocorrelation time of the squared topological charge and the statistical uncertainty on the topological susceptibility remain under control throughout the explored parameter range with currently available computational resources. This marks an important step toward the use of even more efficient flow-based architectures for ergodic sampling of topology in state-of-the-art lattice gauge theory calculations.

translated_title: 利用随机归一化流实现向连续极限的遍历拓扑采样
translated_abstract: 在本工作中，我们提供了数值证据，表明基于流的方法可以缓解 SU(3) 杨-米尔斯理论中的拓扑冻结问题，并在细至 0.03 fm 的格距上进行了测试。我们通过分析一种将开放边界条件与随机归一化流相结合的计算策略的成本标度行为来做到这一点。结果表明，在现有计算资源下，拓扑荷平方的积分自关联时间以及拓扑磁化率的统计不确定性在整个探索的参数范围内均保持在可控水平。这标志着在使用更高效的基于流的架构对最先进格点规范理论计算中的拓扑进行遍历采样方面迈出了重要一步。
tldr: 本研究通过结合开放边界条件与随机归一化流的计算策略，提供了数值证据表明在细至 0.03 fm 的格距下可有效缓解 SU(3) 杨-米尔斯理论中的拓扑冻结问题。
en_tdlr: This work provides numerical evidence that combining open boundary conditions with Stochastic Normalizing Flows can mitigate topological freezing in SU(3) Yang-Mills theory at lattice spacings as fine as 0.03 fm.
